items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button with ten variants, five sizes, five icon-only sizes and a loading state that keeps its width.

items.name: close-button
items.title: Close Button
items.description: An icon-only button that shows an X, in four sizes and a light or dark theme. Use it to dismiss a banner, panel or any surface that has no built-in close control.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A read-only preview card that opens on hover or keyboard focus of a link, so people can see what it points to without navigating. Use it for static previews such as a profile or page summary; use a popover when the content needs interaction.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A click-triggered popup anchored to its trigger that can hold interactive content such as inputs and buttons. Use it for a small form or settings panel; for text-only hints, reach for a tooltip or hover card.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that appears on hover or keyboard focus of its trigger, with an optional description line and arrow. Use it to name an icon-only control or add a brief hint; it only holds text, so reach for a popover when the content is interactive.
